name: czgame_frame_on_destroy
description: CZGameFrame::OnDestroy tears down the game-frame runtime state in order: DirectPlay cached local player, video system, CD audio, MFC frame destroy, then owned bitmap.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
CFrameWnd::OnDestroy and CGdiObject::DeleteObject are MFC42 provider contracts.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x443ab0 validates the exact call order: zNetwork_DPlay::DestroyCachedLocalPlayer, zVideo::ShutdownVideoSystem, zSndCd::Stop, CFrameWnd::OnDestroy(self), and CGdiObject::DeleteObject(&self->m_gameBitmap).
The dependency frontier for 0x443ab0 has no source blockers; zNetwork_DPlay::DestroyCachedLocalPlayer, zVideo::ShutdownVideoSystem, and zSndCd::Stop are accepted functional dependencies.
The native smoke patches all five callees/providers and verifies the call order and single dispatch to the MFC/GDI provider methods.
